Name: AYN Thor Companion
Author: Abacus1701
Description:
⚠️ [b]You need a second device or monitor to see anything — and the AYN Thor Companion app.[/b] This mod doesn't draw anything in-game — it runs a small local web server and serves a web page to whatever browser you point at it. [b]Download the AYN Thor Companion app — file [/b]
[code]StardewSecondScreen-0.1.0-debug[/code][b]in the Files section on this page.[/b] In a pinch, you can also open

[code]http://localhost:27301/[/code]in a browser on the same machine to see the HUD. If you install this and just look at your game screen, it will look like nothing happened — that's expected.
[b]What it does[/b]
AynDualScreen serves a live second-screen view of your game — sprites are cropped directly from your own installed copy of Stardew Valley at runtime, so nothing from the base game is bundled or redistributed with the mod.
[b]AYN Thor Companion required.[/b] To view the second screen, you'll need the AYN Thor Companion app — download the file
[code]StardewSecondScreen-0.1.0-debug[/code]from the Files tab on this page. In a pinch, you can also just open

[code]http://localhost:27301/[/code]in any browser on the same machine to see the HUD.
[b]⚠️ LAN access is on by default[/b]
This is worth reading before you install. With LAN access enabled, any device on your local network can open the companion page — and depending on your settings, that page can move, drop, or destroy items in your inventory. If you want it locked down:
[list]
[*]Set[/*]
[/list]
[code]AllowLanAccess: false[/code]to restrict it to the same machine only.
[list]
[*]Use[/*]
[/list]
[code]AllowTrash[/code],

[code]AllowDrop[/code],

[code]AllowInventoryEdit[/code], and

[code]AllowEat[/code]to make the page read-only or limit what it can do.
[b]Requirements[/b]
[list]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[/list][b]Contains AI-assisted code[/b]
Flagging this up front: parts of this mod were built with AI assistance.
[b]Assets & licensing[/b]
No game assets are included — everything displayed is pulled live from your own installed copy of the game. This mod is All Rights Reserved: personal use only. No redistribution, modification, reuploads, modpacks, or code reuse without explicit permission from the author. If you want to use, modify, or build on any part of this mod, reach out first.[size=5][b]A second screen for Stardew Valley[/b][/size]

Your inventory, the farm map, villagers, the day's forecast and the community
centre move off the main screen and onto a phone, tablet or handheld sitting
next to you. The game window stays clean.

[b]This mod draws nothing in-game.[/b] It runs a small web server inside your
own game and serves a page to whatever screen you point at it. If you install
it and only look at your monitor, it will look like nothing happened. That is
expected - the whole point is that it is somewhere else.

Nothing leaves your house. No account, no server of mine, no internet.

[b]Source:[/b] [url=https://github.com/Abacus1829/ayn-dual-screen]github.com/Abacus1829/ayn-dual-screen[/url]

[line]

[size=5][b]How to use it[/b][/size]

[b]1. Install the mod.[/b] Drop the AynDualScreen folder into Stardew Valley\Mods\ so you end up with Mods\AynDualScreen\AynDualScreen.dll

[b]2. Start the game through SMAPI and load a save.[/b] Watch the console. The mod prints the address to use:

[code][Ayn Dual Screen] On your handheld, open: http://192.168.1.20:27301/[/code]
[b]3. Open that address on your second device.[/b] Any browser will do - Android, iPhone, iPad, a laptop, an old tablet in a drawer. Nothing to install on it.

[b][color=#ffcc66]Do not type "localhost" on the second device.[/color][/b] localhost means "this device", so on a phone it points the phone at itself and fails every time. This is the single most common reason it looks broken. Use the numeric address the console prints.

[i]localhost:27301 does work in a browser on the PC running the game - handy for a quick look, or a second monitor.[/i]

[line]

[size=5][b]Two ways to view it[/b][/size]

[b]Any web browser.[/b] Nothing to install. Type the address in and you are done. This is the normal way to use it and it works on anything.

[b]Or the companion app, if you have an AYN Thor.[/b] "Abacus's Dual Screen Interface" finds the game on your network by itself and opens the page full-screen on the Thor's second panel, with no browser bars in the way. It is a free sideload APK - no ads, no purchases, no account - and it also handles Terraria and Minecraft, so one app covers all three.

Get it from the Files tab here, or from the GitHub link above. The mod does not need it; it just makes things nicer on a handheld built for exactly this.

[line]

[size=5][b]What's on the second screen[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]Inventory[/b] with real item sprites, your tools and their upgrade level, health, energy, money and the time.[/*]
[*][b]A live map[/b] of wherever you are, with villagers, monsters, animals and forage marked.[/*]
[*][b]Villager tracker[/b] - who is where, hearts, birthdays, and who you have not spoken to today.[/*]
[*][b]Daily dashboard[/b] - weather, luck, the travelling cart, birthdays and festivals.[/*]
[*][b]Community centre tracker[/b] showing which bundles are done and what the rest still need.[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b][color=#ff6666]Read this before you install: the defaults are permissive[/color][/b][/size]

Out of the box this mod is set up for convenience on a trusted home network, not for lockdown. Two things are true at once:

[list]
[*][b]LAN access is on.[/b] Any device on your local network can open the page.[/*]
[*][b]The controls that change your save are on.[/b] Trash, drop, rearrange inventory and eat are all enabled by default.[/*]
[/list]
Together that means anyone already on your network can move, drop, eat or destroy items in your inventory. On your own home Wi-Fi that is fine and it is what makes the mod useful. On shared, student or public networks, change it before you play.

Everything is in [b]config.json[/b], created in the mod folder on first run:

[list]
[*][code]AllowLanAccess[/code]- set to [b]false[/b] to allow only the machine running the game. The single most effective change.[/*]
[*][code]AllowTrash[/code]- the destructive one. Set to false first if you change nothing else.[/*]
[*][code]AllowDrop[/code],
[code]AllowInventoryEdit[/code],
[code]AllowEat[/code]- set to false to make the page read-only.[/*]
[*][code]Port[/code]- default 27301.[/*]
[*][code]ShowMonsters[/code],
[code]ShowNpcs[/code],
[code]ShowAnimals[/code]- what appears on the map.[/*]
[*][code]UpdatesPerSecond[/code]- default 10. Lower it if you ever see it cost frames.[/*]
[*][code]EnableItemIcons[/code]- turn off to skip sprite extraction entirely.[/*]
[/list]
Setting every Allow* option to false gives you a display that can look but not touch.

[line]

[size=5][b]Requirements[/b][/size]

[list]
[*]Stardew Valley[/*]
[*]SMAPI 4.0.0 or later[/*]
[*]A second device on the same network - or just a browser window on the same PC[/*]
[/list]
[line]

[size=5][b]If it will not connect[/b][/size]

[list]
[*][b]You typed localhost on the phone.[/b] See above. This is most of the reports.[/*]
[*][b]A VPN is running on the PC.[/b] The next most common cause. VPN clients capture your network routes, so the PC becomes unreachable from your own Wi-Fi. Turn it off and try again.[/*]
[*][b]Windows Firewall.[/b] Allow Stardew Valley for Private networks the first time it asks.[/*]
[*][b]Different networks.[/b] A 2.4GHz guest network and the main one often cannot see each other.[/*]
[*][b]The address changed.[/b] Your router usually hands it out and it can change after a reboot. The console prints the current one every launch.[/*]
[/list]
The console lines starting with [b][Ayn Dual Screen][/b] usually say what is wrong in plain English.

[line]

[size=5][b]Contains AI-assisted code[/b][/size]

Flagging this up front: parts of this mod were built with AI assistance. If that is a dealbreaker, this is not the mod for you.

[line]

[size=5][b]Assets and licence[/b][/size]

[b]No game assets are included.[/b] Every sprite you see is cropped at runtime from your own installed copy of Stardew Valley and served only to your own screen. Nothing from the base game is bundled or redistributed.

This mod is [b]source-available[/b], not open source. You may read it, modify it for your own use, and send improvements back on GitHub. You may include an unmodified build in a non-commercial modpack with credit and a link, no need to ask.

You may not reupload it, publish the source or a build as your own, sell it, or put it behind a paywall or ad-gate. Full terms are in LICENSE.txt and in the repository.
